answer: Alt-click (Option-click on Mac) the rendered link to reveal its underlying markdown. Then select and copy it. This works on read-only pages and doesn't let you edit the page. The source stays visible while your selection touches it. It renders again once you move entirely outside it. This is described in `Live Preview.md` and `Guide/Reading These Docs.md`.
